title: First Crude Oil Exported via Chad-Cameroon Pipeline
reason: Independently corroborated: Chad's first crude oil cargo (950,000 bbl) was loaded on 3 October 2003 from the FSO vessel offshore Kribi, Cameroon, via the newly completed Chad-Cameroon pipeline, marking Chad's entry into oil export markets. The description's claim that oil revenues transformed Chad's fiscal position and became a source of political controversy over fund management is also well-documented (World Bank-mandated revenue management law, later disputes/2005-06 amendment fights are widely reported in later sources). Year and country match exactly; no material detail is off.
